entries.name: SlotChainInbox (Settlement implementation)
abiOrEncoding: new implementation installed in the EXISTING L1 Inbox proxy; V1 storage slots 251-257 (activationTimestamp, _coreState, _proposalHashes, _forcedInclusionStorage, _bondStorage) are preserved and Slot Chain state follows them

DRAINING mode keeps V1 prove/bond paths live, rejects saveForcedInclusion and permits propose only while the V1 forced-inclusion queue is non-empty; ACTIVATE via activateSlotChainV1(bytes headerRlp) once nextProposalId-1 == lastFinalizedProposalId and the V1 queue is empty

CanonicalCore = (l2BlockNumber, tipHash, tipSlot, stateRoot, messageCursor, winningDataCommitment, nextBaseFee, nextExcessBlobGas); every canonical commit calls ISignalService.saveCheckpoint(uint48 l2BlockNumber, tipHash, stateRoot) exactly once as the proxy's authorized syncer
SettlementStatementV2 public-input schema string slot-chain-settlement-validity-public-input-schema-v3; executionOutputsCommitment domain slot-chain-outputs-v3
protocolVersion is an implementation immutable bound into the EIP-712 signed header and every context ID; settlementForcedIngressFloorV1() (SIF1) is read by the ForcedQueue
failureBranches: activation header hash/RLP/uint48/timestamp/L1-checkpoint mismatch, non-empty V1 queue, unfinalized V1 proposals, failed saveCheckpoint (rolls back the canonical commit), proof/returndata/gas/replay faults
limits: runtime<=24576 bytes; endL2BlockNumber<=UINT48_MAX (ICheckpointStore uses uint48)
upgrade only by the DAO owner through _authorizeUpgrade; storage layout verified with gen-layouts/review-layout before every upgrade
design-blocker: implementation, DRAINING/ACTIVATE state machine and settlement window not yet written

entries.name: ForcedQueue
abiOrEncoding: new DAO-owned ERC-1967/UUPS proxy; enqueueForcedTransactionV2(bytes rawTransaction, uint64 validUntil, address refundAddress) payable returns (uint8 result, uint64 queueIndex) lives directly on the queue (no ingress adapter, no Router facade, no authorizedIngress rows)

kind-0 envelope (sender, nonce, l2ChainId, rawTxHash, byteLength, gasLimit, maxFee, validUntil, refundAddress, deposit); 220-byte durable descriptor and 204-byte admission body; leaf domain slot-chain-force-user-v2; descriptor schema hash H(slot-chain-force-descriptor-schema-v12)

dueAt = max(enqueuedAt + FORCE_DELAY, lastDueAt, minimumDueAt) with the Settlement ingress floor read by a bounded static call to the Inbox proxy; depth-64 Merkle vector, frontier, advanceCursor (Settlement only, constructor immutable), pull credits and EXPIRED_NO_TX expiry
failureBranches: non-EIP-155/2930/1559 grammar, fee below schedule, deposit above cap, validUntil in the past, advanceCursor from a non-Settlement caller, enqueue before activation, insolvent custody
limits: accountedGas = max(gasLimit, intrinsicGas, MIN_FORCE_ACCOUNTED_GAS) capped by MAX_FORCE_MESSAGE_GAS = 5,000,000; MAX_FORCE_MESSAGE_BYTES = 131,072
per-block forced budgets count<=64, bytes<=1 MiB, accountedGas<=20,000,000; candidate caps 256 items, 4 MiB, 80m gas
design-blocker: contract not yet written
